Connect your AWS account to use Amazon B:
Amazon Bedrock AI modellaridan foydalanish uchun AWS hisobingizni ulang.

1. [AWS IAM Console](https://console.aws.amazon.com/iam/) ni ochib, **Users** bo'limiga o'ting.
2. Foydalanuvchingizni tanlang (yoki yangisini yarating), so'ng **Security credentials** bo'limiga o'ting.
3. **Create access key** ni bosing — Access Key ID va Secret Access Key ni nusxa oling.
4. Faqat shu integratsiya foydalanadigan Bedrock amallariga ruxsat beruvchi siyosatni ulang: `bedrock:ListFoundationModels`, `bedrock:ListInferenceProfiles`, `bedrock:InvokeModel` va `bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream`. **AmazonBedrockFullAccess** kabi keng siyosatlardan saqlaning — eng kam imtiyoz tamoyiliga amal qiling, shunda oshkor bo'lgan kalit kam zarar keltiradi.
5. [AWS Bedrock Console](https://console.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/) da **Model access** bo'limiga o'tib, foydalanmoqchi bo'lgan modellarga ruxsat so'rang.

1. Gateway yaratish uchun https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/get-started/ ga o'ting, so'ng unga dashboarddan kiring.

3. https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/configuration/authentication/#setting-up-authenticated-gateway-using-the-dashboard sahifasiga qarab AI Gateway tokenini yarating.
4. Gateway dashboardingizda providers bo'limiga o'tib, har bir provayder uchun API kalitlaringizni qo'shing.
5. Barcha oldingi bosqichlarni bajarib, kerakli maydonlarni to'ldirganingizdan so'ng modellar qo'shing, lekin model id oldiga provayder nomini qo'shishni unutmang, masalan (openai/gpt-4o) yoki (anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet); batafsil ma'lumot uchun https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/usage/chat-completion/ ga qarang.
